verdict.rationale: Rive documents an official MCP connection between the Rive Editor and AI tools, and RML gives coding agents a text-based XML representation of a Rive file they can read and modify. However, the documented MCP tools are aimed at agents creating content inside Rive (View Models, State Machines, Layouts, Shapes), not at extracting design context to implement it in an external codebase. missing for 10: documented read or extraction tools for frames, variables and screenshots; component-to-code mappings; tool-level MCP reference docs; independent or hands-on corroboration of agents pulling design context.
